overview_description.description:
Arabee is an edtech company that provides a digital platform for teaching the Arabic language to children through interactive online learning tools. The platform offers a structured program designed for children aged 3–12 years to learn Arabic skills, including listening, speaking, reading, and writing.
Founded in 2017 in the United Arab Emirates, Arabee Learning develops educational technology solutions used by schools and families to teach Arabic through gamified lessons, videos, digital books, songs, and interactive activities. The platform includes thousands of learning activities and multimedia resources that help children practice vocabulary, pronunciation, and basic grammar while progressing through different levels of the curriculum.
